Installation

Fluxor runs on any modern JavaScript runtime. This page walks you through installing the command-line tool and creating your first project.

Requirements

  • Node.js version 20 or above
  • A terminal with access to your project folder
Tip

You can try Fluxor online without installing anything by opening the interactive playground.

Install the CLI

  • npm
  • pnpm
  • yarn
npm install --global fluxor

After the installation finishes, check that everything works by printing the version number.

Installation fails with a permission error

Avoid running the installer as an administrator. Configure your package manager to use a folder inside your home directory instead.
